rubrics.justification: Gives a broadly plausible blastocyst description and acknowledges image limitations, but is inconsistent about stage (3 vs expanded/4), adds uncertain visual details, and does not tightly anchor morphology to the provided image/lab grade.

Integrates key factors including maternal age, smoking, BMI, first cycle status, sperm parameters, day-5 transfer, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality, though some factors are overemphasized or speculative.
Contains multiple internal inconsistencies and repeated shifting estimates (25-40%, 30-45%, 35-50%, 60-70% if euploid), plus contradictory statements about morphology and semen interpretation.

Mostly consistent with general IVF principles (single embryo transfer, smoking cessation, morphology not equal to ploidy), but includes questionable claims about thick endometrium, semen interpretation, and grading nuances.

Provides some practical advice for transfer and future planning (SET, smoking cessation, cavity review if needed, consider PGT-A), but recommendations are somewhat generic and diluted by speculative points.
